data.name: Mounesh
data.gender_notes: Mounesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mouna means 'silent' in Sanskrit. The name Mounesh signifies a peaceful and calm individual. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as 'Mouna Rudra,' symbolizing his silent and powerful nature. The name Mounesh carries the meaning “Silent, peaceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mounesh usually hope their child will grow to embody silent, peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embraces silence and tranquility in spiritual practice.
data.etymology: Mounesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Silent, peaceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mounesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
